item.title: RUMOR: Tramell Tillman's SPIDER-MAN Role Revealed; Plans For Damage Control Extend Into Marvel's X-MEN Reboot
item.description: New details about Marvel Studios' plans for the Department of Damage Control have been revealed, including how their return in Wonder Man and Spider-Man: Brand New Day ties into the X-Men reboot.

item.title: Warner Bros.’ Board Of Directors Rejects David Ellison’s Hostile Bid; Says Paramount Has “Misled” Shareholders
item.description: The Warner Bros. Discovery board of directors has officially rejected David Ellison’s $108 billion hostile offer for the company, claiming Paramount “misled” investors in its proposal.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY - Returning MCU Star Rumored To Play "Multiple" Versions Of Their Character - SPOILERS
item.description: According to a new rumor, a certain actor from the earliest days of the MCU will play multiple versions of their character in Avengers: Doomsday...

item.title: SUPERMAN Star David Corenswet Inadvertently Sparks Fan Speculation About DC Studios Having Finally Cast Batman
item.description: Superman and Man of Tomorrow actor David Corenswet has led fans to believe DC Studios has finally found its Batman after following a fan-favorite actor for the role.

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH Eyes Huge $365 Million Launch At The Worldwide Box Office - But Will It Reach $2 Billion?
item.description: James Cameron will take us back to Pandora this weekend, and Avatar: Fire and Ash is eyeing a strong start both domestically and overseas. Whether it will eventually reach $2 billion is another matter.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Leaked Trailer: Everything We Learned About The Wall-Crawler's Next Movie
item.description: The first Spider-Man: Brand New Day teaser trailer leaked online yesterday, and we're now taking a deep dive into what it reveals about the wall-crawler's long-awaited MCU return.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Test Screening Reports Are Mostly Positive; New Details On Lobo And Movie's "Underwhelming" Villain
item.description: The first reactions from early Supergirl test screenings have landed, and as well as providing insights into the runtime and characters, it sounds like the movie is good...but not great.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY - Rumored Details On [SPOILER]'s MCU Future And Trailers #3 & #4 Revealed
item.description: Some new rumors are doing the rounds following the recent Avengers: Doomsday leaks, and they may reveal what's in store for the child of a certain OG Earth's Mightiest Hero...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Leaks Online In HD As Rumors Of A FIFTH Trailer Surface
item.description: The best quality version of the first Avengers: Doomsday tease we’ve seen has shown up on social media, all while rumours swirl about plans to eventually release a fifth sneak peek.

item.title: James Cameron Confirms Arnold Schwarzenegger Won't Star In His TERMINATOR Reboot; Casts Doubt On AVATAR 4
item.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash director James Cameron has confirmed that he won't bring Arnold Schwarzenegger back for his Terminator reboot, and suggests he'll be less hands-on if Avatar 4 happens.
